rationale: The agent did not follow key policy steps. Although it executed a cancellation, it (1) did not explicitly confirm with the user before performing the order-changing write, (2) did not verify whether partial cancellation was possible despite the user’s conditional instruction, (3) did not show evidence that the order belonged to the authenticated user beyond a lookup by email and order details (no explicit association check), and (4) stated an unsupported detail about refunding to PayPal without tool evidence. These issues violate the requirements to authenticate, act only on the user’s orders, confirm before changes, and avoid unsupported claims.
